passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Lobelia × speciosa Sweet.
The native range of this hybrid is SE. Canada to N. Central U.S.A. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is L. cardinalis × L. siphilitica.
